exposure: Number of vaccine doses (two vs. three)
cohort: Pregnant women who received the BNT162b2 vaccine during pregnancy
finding: Receiving the booster (third) dose of the BNT162b2 vaccine during pregnancy, compared to only receiving the first two doses, was not associated with an increased rate of adverse obstetric or early neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Lower rates of urgent cesarean delivery were observed in the group who received the third vaccine dose.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at vaccination: 21.2 weeks for the third dose group and 31.5 weeks for the two-dose group
